item.title: How America's Most Hated Airline Died | The Spirit Airlines Collapse
item.description:
At 3 a.m. on May 2, 2026, Spirit Airlines stopped flying for good. For most of its life the bright yellow budget airline was the most complained-about carrier in America, and also one of the most profitable. So how did it end in liquidation after 34 years?
It didn't die from one mistake. It took five blows: the big airlines copied its best idea, regulators blocked its rescue, an engine flaw grounded its planes, debt piled up, and a fuel shock finished it off.
